unimplemented_or_partial: The simulator executes a subset of the 20 catalogued adversarial cases and reports the others as not_executed.
When AA_DEMO_AGENT_TOKEN is unset, startup generates a random internal credential for local scenario simulation; the admin API issues short-lived hashed credentials and supports revocation.
Demo sessions are explicitly switchable fixtures, not production authentication or enterprise SSO.
Payments are simulated; no provider adapter or external exactly-once guarantee exists.
Some policy checks outside invocation and payment submission still use the bootstrap embedded policy; those checks remain outside runtime policy replacement.
